rule: Every user action traces ui_source -> command -> canonical_owner -> validation_permission -> state_mutation_or_operation -> event/receipt/ObservableWork -> ui_projection -> usage/diagnostic_attribution -> recovery/deep_link. No concept-only local state may masquerade as production wiring. Command IDs are provisional pending audit adjudication.

traces.ui_source: Settings destination panel (cr-dest) or TOC sub-manage link, click
traces.canonical_owner: ManagerShell over owner doc (Memory->assistant-memory-subsystem; Personas->Personas; Crew->orchestrator-subagent-integration; Permissions->Permissions_System; Provider->CLI_Bridged_Providers/Provider_OpenCode)
traces.validation_permission: settings_read + manager-specific read (memory_read|persona_read|crew_read|permissions_read|provider_read); verify manager registered and not unavailable
traces.state_mutation_or_operation: set active manager in workspace state; progressive-hydrate manager (does NOT block entire Settings workspace)
traces.event_receipt_ObservableWork: navigation_wrapper event; manager load emits ObservableWork if resources hydrate async
traces.ui_projection: ManagerShell renders: header, search/filter, add/connect/create, HealthSummary, resource list, requested/effective inspector; backbar crumb updated
traces.usage_diagnostic_attribution: manager_opened{manager_id} attribution to settings.usage + manager owner diagnostic
traces.recovery_deeplink: back to Home/category; deep-link settings/<category>/<manager> restores view

traces.ui_source: TOC subcategory button or search result select, click; or external deep-link URL
traces.state_mutation_or_operation: update active category/subcategory; compute jump offset (PM.jumpOffset); scroll document; derive active-index from portable section model (NOT DOM geometry)
traces.event_receipt_ObservableWork: navigation_wrapper event with deep-link; no ObservableWork (synchronous scroll)
traces.ui_projection: TOC highlights active subcategory; document scrolls; sticky backbar crumb updated

traces.validation_permission: memory_write; verify evidence_ref provided when verify-without-evidence policy is off
traces.state_mutation_or_operation: update Gist verified state + provenance; half-life/active-context status unchanged (fade not delete)
traces.event_receipt_ObservableWork: durable memory event (memory.gist verified) with provenance; ObservableWork receipt
traces.ui_projection: MemoryRow verified/unverified badge updates; provenance tooltip refreshes; capsule token estimate unchanged
traces.recovery_deeplink: toggle verified back; deep-link to Gist detail

traces.ui_source: MemoryRow edit action; inline editor save
traces.state_mutation_or_operation: create new Gist version (version history); update active-context status; half-life unaffected
traces.event_receipt_ObservableWork: durable memory event with new version id; ObservableWork for capsule re-estimate
traces.ui_projection: MemoryRow content updates; version-history entry appears; capsule token estimate refreshes
traces.recovery_deeplink: cmd.memory.restore prior version; deep-link to version history

traces.validation_permission: persona_write; enforce behavior-not-authority (cannot widen FileSafe, grant Full Access, force provider, eagerly load all skills); child-only flag respected
traces.state_mutation_or_operation: set active persona for scope (thread/project/global); record capsule preview
traces.event_receipt_ObservableWork: durable persona event (does NOT use retired requested_persona_id/effective_persona_id payload fields); ObservableWork for capsule re-render
traces.ui_projection: PersonaCard active state; model-facing capsule preview updates; mission/use boundary shown
traces.recovery_deeplink: restore prior persona; deep-link to Persona detail

traces.ui_source: Persona manager import action; file picker
traces.validation_permission: persona_write + import_scan; run trust/secret/prompt-injection scan before apply
traces.state_mutation_or_operation: stage imported persona; apply only after scan passes; authority-widening blocked
traces.event_receipt_ObservableWork: durable persona event + scan result disclosure; ObservableWork during scan
traces.ui_projection: import diff dialog with scan result; apply disabled until scan passes
traces.recovery_deeplink: discard import; deep-link to scan report

traces.ui_source: Crew manager create-template action; template editor save
traces.validation_permission: crew_write; validate min<=max members, allowed provider/account/model candidates non-empty, diversity satisfiable, reserve within capacity ceiling
traces.state_mutation_or_operation: persist Crew template (Orchestrator-owned); requested members/concurrency/waves stored; effective computed at runtime
traces.event_receipt_ObservableWork: durable crew event with requested vs effective projection; ObservableWork if reserve preflight runs
traces.ui_projection: CrewTemplate card appears; RequestedEffectiveInspector shows requested (effective pending runtime)
traces.recovery_deeplink: delete template; deep-link to template editor

traces.ui_source: PermissionRuleEditor add-rule action; rule form save
traces.validation_permission: permissions_write; rule MUST NOT bypass FileSafe floor or widen authority; doom-loop threshold checked
traces.state_mutation_or_operation: insert ordered last-match-wins rule at position; compute effective_rules + sample effective result
traces.event_receipt_ObservableWork: durable permission event with revision + effective-result disclosure
traces.ui_projection: PermissionRuleEditor list updates with new rule; effective-result sample shown; FileSafe floor badge unchanged
traces.recovery_deeplink: cmd.permissions.rule.delete or reorder; deep-link to rule in editor

traces.validation_permission: permissions_write; reorder MUST NOT widen authority (re-evaluate effective rules)
traces.state_mutation_or_operation: reorder ordered rule list; recompute effective (last-match-wins)
traces.ui_projection: PermissionRuleEditor list reorders; effective-result sample refreshes

traces.state_mutation_or_operation: no mutation; compute effective decision (allow|deny|ask), matched rule, FileSafe floor applicability
traces.event_receipt_ObservableWork: diagnostic disclosure only; no durable mutation event
traces.ui_projection: test result panel: effective decision, matched rule, FileSafe floor applies badge

traces.ui_source: Back Seat Driver setting row (Off/Auto/On), select
traces.canonical_owner: Plans/Run_Modes.md (BSD owner) via settings value contract
traces.validation_permission: settings_write; BSD cannot widen authority; On requires acknowledgment of all-turns inspection
traces.state_mutation_or_operation: update BSD mode default; runtime honors read-only/bounded-delta constraints; cannot block primary work on its own failure
traces.event_receipt_ObservableWork: durable setting-mutation event; ObservableWork if restart/reconnect required
traces.ui_projection: BSD row effective value updates; advanced config (route, risk/phase triggers, usage guard, latency budget, privacy boundary, tool access, health) reflects mode
traces.recovery_deeplink: cmd.settings.default.restore; chat override remains one-turn/current-thread scoped

traces.ui_source: Provider family card refresh action, click
traces.state_mutation_or_operation: refresh model/skill catalog; record source version, check/import/activation times; preserve last-known-good rows during load
traces.event_receipt_ObservableWork: ObservableWork for refresh progress; durable catalog event with freshness + change history
traces.ui_projection: provider family rows show loading then refreshed catalog; last-known-good preserved on failure; freshness timestamp updates
traces.recovery_deeplink: fall back to last-known-good; deep-link to catalog change history

traces.validation_permission: provider_auth; auth_boundary respected: cli_owned (Claude/Antigravity CLI) launches native flow, NO PM-direct OAuth; pm_direct (OpenAI/Codex/GitHub/Copilot) uses PM OAuth; api_key uses vault reference
traces.state_mutation_or_operation: re-establish connection; record last_successful_connection; update health
traces.event_receipt_ObservableWork: durable connection event; ObservableWork during auth flow (native or PM OAuth)
traces.ui_projection: AccountConnectionRow health updates; visible success/failure result; last successful connection timestamp
ModelRow favorite state updates; model visibility filter reflects change
traces.recovery_deeplink: toggle off; deep-link to model detail

traces.ui_source: InstallationCard explicit Install action (official source), click
traces.validation_permission: provider_install + host_write; explicit user-triggered (no baseline bundling/pre-seeding/silent demand-install)
traces.state_mutation_or_operation: install from official source on exact Host/Environment; post-install verification plan queued
traces.event_receipt_ObservableWork: ObservableWork for install + verification (path, launch health, auth/profile, catalog, adapter handshake, capability, route refresh — not installer exit code alone)
traces.ui_projection: InstallationCard update state transitions Ready->Installing->Verifying->Ready; confidence Proven/Strongly-identified on success
traces.recovery_deeplink: cmd.provider.installation.rollback or repair on verification failure; deep-link to install log
